lesson.title_tag: Professor View -- Rodrigo Luiz | Lesson 26 -- Since 2019
lesson.grammar_point: present perfect with for and since (how long)

listenings.text: Hi Rodrigo, it's Tom. You asked about our plant in New Jersey. We have been in this building since 2008. I have worked here for twelve years, and I have been the plant manager since 2020. Our team has grown a lot: we have had a night shift for three years now. See you in October!

Hi Rodrigo, it's Nora. A fun fact for your visit: our office in New York has been on Park Avenue since 2016. I have lived in New York for nine years, and I have worked with Claire since last year. And the coffee machine? It has been broken for two weeks! Sorry about that.

extra_audio.text: The group was founded in France in 1850. Many decades later, it opened a subsidiary in Brazil. Rodrigo joined the company and worked in planning. He got a promotion in 2019. He has been the Operations Director since then.

reading.rtitle: A Short Timeline -- The Group and the Plant in Brazil
paras: The group was founded in 1850, in Grasse, France. It has made flavors and fragrances for more than 170 years.
The world. The group has had subsidiaries in Asia and in the Americas for many decades. Since 2015, the growth in Asia has been very fast.
Brazil. The plant in Brazil has worked with the global team since the 1990s. It has had a new warehouse since 2021, and it has had a quality lab for ten years.
The people. The plant has more than two hundred employees. Some of them have worked there for more than twenty years.
The director. Rodrigo has been the Operations Director since 2019. Before that, he got a promotion every few years.
